statement: Every charity in England and Wales must be registered in the Charity Commission's register of charities unless an exception in section 30(2) applies; the exceptions cover exempt charities, certain excepted charities whose gross income is £100,000 or less, and any charity whose gross income does not exceed £5,000.
caveat: Sections 30 to 34 are disapplied for charitable incorporated organisations by the Charitable Incorporated Organisations (General) Regulations 2012 (S.I. 2012/3012), and a CIO is registered as part of its creation. Gross income is measured under section 30(4) by the financial year immediately preceding the relevant time. Scotland and Northern Ireland have their own regulators and registration rules.
